svg.text: STRATCO SMARTSPAN, PALE GREY (SHALE GREY ASSUMED)
QUAD GUTTER ON THE LOW (WEST) EDGE, 90 PVC DOWNPIPE, POSITION TBC
EXISTING EAVE / GUTTER (TO 620 OUT): NEW ROOF FLIES OVER ON BRACKETS
100 SHS POST ON THE LOUNGE WALL'S CAP
240 BEAM UNDER, 3740 LONG, FLY-OVER BRACKET AT HOUSE END
For Bob Bruce to draw up.
SCALE 1:50 @ A3, AT MID-DEPTH OF THE ROOF, LOOKING NORTH
Roof 4453 x 4150 plan, from 300 off the house wall to 4450 (south edge). West edge on the
Fall 2° to the west. Top 3000 above the paving at the east (high) side, 2845 at the west.
Ceiling flush, 2655 clear at the low side (model, at 300 in from the edge).
The house's rear gutter runs out to 620 from the wall, under the beam line: beams stop at 660
and need a fly-over bracket back to the house framing (or a post at the wall). SK02 runs the
beam to the wall, through the gutter.
High (east) side meets the pavilion roof: assumed carried on the pavilion's column line (SK02
shows no post there). Engineer to confirm.
Drawn at 1:50 (not 1:100) so the 4.45 m roof is legible; the 1:100 context is on A3-01.
Post layout: one post at the roof's south-west corner (1 x 100 SHS post, beams 240 deep as
modelled; sizes not engineered). Rafters 140x35 at 900 per the estimate.
